name: Hack squat
cue: Sink deep with your back on the pad and your heels down.
research: research.json biomech.hack_squat: 45 deg rails, back pad parallel to them (trunk -45 throughout), feet ~32 cm apart, toes out 10 deg; hip 86 -> 20, knee 115 -> 10, ankle 31 -> -8, hip abduction 12 -> 8; closed chain hip - knee + ankle = plate tilt - 45. The research plate is perpendicular to the rails (sole 47 deg toes-up), which puts the researched depth at ankle 31, past the rig dorsiflexion limit (28); the plate here is tilted 42 deg (commercial plates span ~20-63 deg), keeping the researched hip and knee depth with the heels down (ankle 26 at depth, -13 at lockout). One fixed stance width gives hip abduction 14 at depth and 4 at lockout (knees track out over the toes). The trunk is rigid on the carriage (sacrum pinned to it), the carriage slides 0.24 H (0.43 m) down and forward along the rails, and foot IK keeps the soles flat on the fixed plate. Hands on horn handles in front of and outside the shoulder pads (shoulder flexion 20, abduction 30, elbow 120 in the trunk frame; humerus externally rotated so the forearms run up beside the shoulders). Geometry: tools/design/hack_squat.mjs. Load: plate horns on the back of the carriage behind the shoulder pads (the plates ride down the rails with the carriage). (tools/design/loads.mjs)

camera.note: Research view az 80 / el 5 (profile, turned 10 deg toward the front, so the quads face the camera on the reclined thighs). Turned another 20 deg toward the front and raised 5 deg (az 60 / el 10, 20.6 deg in all): the whole figure and machine - the carriage with its plate horns at the top of the rails at lockout and the foot plate at the bottom right - fit the portrait stage (in the profile view the diagonal machine was wider than the stage, so the head touched the left edge and the plates and foot plate were cropped), and the quads face the camera more (phone stage glow ~1600 CSS px at the stretch and ~2800 at the peak, against 1948 / 2540 in the profile at fill 0.58). fill 0.51 and shiftX 0.02 keep ~10 px of margin at both edges at lockout.

skinChecks.note: left heel and sole stay flat on the plate
right heel and sole stay flat on the plate
